text:
alex_g: heads-up: we're getting a spike of PD pages from api-error-rate across prod clusters — ~400 alerts/min, lots of duplicates. paging oncall. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2098 — high api error rate (auto-detected). Paging 1/3 oncall recipients.
maya_s: seeing identical alerts split by instance id. pretty sure this is alert churn not new root cause. can we throttle/aggregate while we sort root cause?
jordan_l: customer impact? any 5xx increase on requests/sec?
alex_g: yes, 5xx up ~3.2% -> some endpoints returning 503 intermittently. affecting a small subset of customers (A/B), but PD noise is crushing oncall.
ops-bot: I can apply a temporary PagerDuty service snooze. recommend short window while we mitigate, then restore. /ops snooze pd-service api-errors 10m
oncall_backup: +1 to short snooze. but let's also do in-alert aggregation so we don't lose signal.
maya_s: propose ephemeral burst-throttle + group_by service+cluster for 15m. that reduces duplicates but keeps 1 alert per cluster if it's real. patch alertmanager with something like:
```
route:
  receiver: production-pagerduty
  group_by: ["service","cluster"]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 2m
  repeat_interval: 1h
inhibit_rules: []
```
then add a `burst_throttle` rule in front to limit 5 notifications/min for the service.
jordan_l: can you paste the exact `kubectl` commands? I'll run them.
maya_s: sure — run in monitoring namespace, validate and apply: 
```
kubectl -n monitoring get secret alertmanager-config -o yaml > /tmp/am.yaml
# edit am.yaml to add grouping/throttle
kubectl -n monitoring apply -f /tmp/am.yaml
```
(we usually use the `alertmanager-config` secret; double-check CI/CD flow before editing directly)
sre_tooling: quick option: create a temporary silencing rule in Alertmanager UI for `api-error-rate` with label `cluster=prod` for 15m. less invasive.
alex_g: opt for Alertmanager UI silence + PD snooze now. can we also create an ephemeral dashboard cell that shows grouped alerts so product teams can see one line per cluster? link below.
ops-bot: PagerDuty: snoozed service `api-errors` for 10 minutes (snooze id: snooze-4829).
incident-bot: Added note: mitigations in progress — Alertmanager silence + PagerDuty snooze.
oncall_backup: I'm creating the dashboard panel now: https://internal.redwood/d/alerts/clustered-api-errors?panelId=7 (temp)
maya_s: created a runbook checklist in the incident thread: 1) silence duplicates 2) group_by 3) find root cause 4) adjust threshold if noise persists.
jordan_l: root cause initial triage: looks like a transient upstream dependency timeout spiking connection errors. investigating feature-flagged retries.
alex_g: ok, after we stabilize, let's follow up with an alert-tuning ticket: reduce sensitivity on low-traffic endpoints, add stronger grouping, and add a 1m burst window in AM. owner: maya_s. ticket: MON-1234
oncall_backup: applied silence & created dashboard. confirmed PD pages dropped to <5/min. monitoring alerts grouped to 3 heads (one per cluster).
maya_s: nice — can we avoid changing thresholds permanently right now? want to capture real regressions. temporary throttles + grouping for 2-4 hours then revert and follow up.
alex_g: agreed. i'll hand off to @maya_s for the post-incident tuning. i'm going offline in 10m — @oncall_backup please keep an eye for reoccurrence and escalate if >5% 5xx persists.
oncall_backup: ack, i'll watch the grouped panel and PD noise. will escalate to SRE lead if we see re-escalation.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2098 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned to maya_s for follow-up.
maya_s: will own tuning & small dashboards. creating PR with proposed Alertmanager grouping + brief rationale. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/alerting/pulls/456 (WIP)
alex_g: thanks all. postmortem + alert-tuning follow-up after 24h window. :white_check_mark:
(reacts: alex_g :thumbsup: to maya_s)
